name: build-journey-use-case-dtos
example-prompts: Execute the build-journey-use-case-dtos graph for journey cart using the latest cart-page analysis.
Run the build-journey-use-case-dtos graph for journey account and domain account-page.

instructions: Execute this job in Latest mode.
Use the journey domain identifier suffixed with -journey to locate the latest managed output (for example, account resolves to account-journey).
Use the journey domain identifier provided to the graph.
Execute this mode twice, first once in latest mode and second once in default mode, this is in order to iterate and improve existing data flow graphs.
Use the journey domain identifier suffixed with -journey to locate the latest managed output or write the new managed output (for example, account resolves to account-journey).
If no use case was offered as an input you must halt execution and ask for the use case that must be present on the latest analyze-journey-use-cases Markdown currently available in context.
